hint.holdStill: Hold your hand still for about 1 s

error.denied: Magic Hand is not allowed to use the camera.
error.deniedHelp: Allow camera access in System Settings and restart the app.
error.not-foundHelp: Connect a camera or choose another one in Preferences.
error.busy: The camera is being used by another app.
error.busyHelp: Quit the other app (e.g. Teams or Zoom) and try again.
error.unknownHelp: Try again or choose another camera in Preferences.
error.model: Hand tracking could not be loaded.
error.modelHelp: Restart the app. If that does not help, reinstall it.

accessibility.title: One more permission and you're ready
accessibility.body: To change slides, Magic Hand needs the Accessibility permission on macOS.
